events.title: Morris Chang founds TSMC
events.summary: Morris Chang founded Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company on February 21, 1987 — pioneering the pure-play foundry model.
events.about: TSMC manufactures chips for Apple, NVIDIA, AMD, and Qualcomm without designing its own products — enabling fabless chip companies worldwide. It became the world's most advanced semiconductor fab operator.

narrative.whyChosen: TSMC's foundry model reshaped how the entire chip industry is structured.
narrative.whyImportant: It let startups design chips without building billion-dollar fabs.
narrative.problemSolved: Integrated device manufacturers hoarded fab capacity and IP.
